chainsaw.doc: n31-melee 04b: the chainsaw's bite outside the kill (view only; drawn at gun height on the victim (ShotLift); as katana, weapon chainsaw: CombatArena.wounded on the GRIND contact). style bite: on the near side of the victim (toward Rivet) a jagged kerf cut_m across, ink edge_px under cream core_px, chattering every 3 ticks, and SawMarks.burst (the kill's release starburst) burst_m wide chattering on the teeth for the first 0.6 of flash_ticks (the grind: grind_min_ticks 16 and the hold), the kerf fading over the rest; it follows the victim and a repeat bite refreshes it. No blood here (blood_m 0; the kill's spray is KillSplitFx). flash_ticks 0 = none; --feel=off hides it too.

claw.doc: The claw's jab mark (view only; ClawMarks via CombatArena.wounded and kill_landed, weapon claw; FxView). On the hit frame three parallel rakes across the victim, square to Rivet -> victim: rake_m long (the outer two 0.75 of it), gap_m apart along the blow, cream edged in ink, full length on the hit frame (the hit-stop holds it), thinning and fading over flash_ticks. flash_ticks 0 = none; --feel=off hides it too.

deflect.doc: The plasma sword's deflect mark (view only; DeflectMarks via CombatArena.deflected, FxView). On the bat frame: a cream starburst edged in ink, burst_m across, for flash_ticks; and a cream streak running streak_m along the returned round, fading over streak_ticks, so the round reads as sent back by the swing. flash_ticks 0 = none; --feel=off hides it too.

doc: Lane n7-melee: view-only marks of Rivet's melee that are not a camera effect (those are hit_feel.json rows). Metres and 60 Hz ticks.

katana.doc: n31-melee 04b: the katana's hit mark (view only; drawn at gun height on the victim (ShotLift); ClawMarks/BladeMarks via CombatArena.wounded and kill_landed, weapon katana; FxView). style cut: ONE clean straight line across the victim along the swing's tangent (square to Rivet -> victim, turned tilt_deg), cut_m long, an ink edge edge_px wide under a cream highlight core_px wide, full length on the hit frame, thinning and fading over flash_ticks and following the victim; on a human (not a machine) BEADS red drops blood_m along it welling up over the first third (red = blood). burst_m unused (0). flash_ticks 0 = none; --feel=off hides it too.

plasma_sword.doc: n31-melee 04b: the plasma sword's hit mark (view only; drawn at gun height on the victim (ShotLift); as katana, weapon plasma_sword). style sear: the same cut burnt in the plasma rifle scorch's palette (PlasmaScorchView / KillHoleFx: HOT core with an EMBER heat bloom 2.2x edge_px, cooling to EMBER by half life then to the dark CHAR), core_px a little wider than the katana's, edge_px of ink; no blood (the plasma cauterises; never teal, never red). flash_ticks 0 = none; --feel=off hides it too.

saw.doc: The chainsaw kill made to read at 32 px/m (the audit rank 5: the held cop was a red blob under the saw). KillSplitFx, view only. clear_m: the grind's blood drops are hidden until they have flown this far from the bite, so the held body stays readable and the spray reads as leaving it (0 = the drops print over the body, the before). shake_m: the held body's judder (0.035 = the before, about 1 px at 32 px/m). release_m: on the frame the halves part, a cream starburst edged in ink this wide (the kill frame; a slash along the cut hid on the saw bar), shrinking over 12 ticks (0 = none). --feel=off = the before values.

swing.doc: How far a timed strike cocks back before it lands (view only; StrikeDepth -> RigClips' windup reach: the torso twists back and leans away, then the arm is out on the hit tick, which is unchanged). pullback is keyed by the rig's hold class (held_classes.json: blade and chainsaw swing their own weapon); a hold without a row (no weapon, or a gun: the strike is the claw's jab) takes the claw row. --pullback=off or --feel=off = 0.35 for all (the night's curve, the before). 1 = the full reach mirrored back. arm_back (same keys): how far the striking arm draws back and out with the torso while cocked (0 = it stays, the night's; 1 = fully cocked at the deepest pull); none under the off switches.
